description.value: Avenue Pizza is a pizza-focused restaurant in the heart of Lumby, serving a wide range from classic pies to gourmet specialty pizzas alongside wings, poutine, wraps, and salads. It is a full sit-down and call-ahead spot that has been a local staple in this small North Okanagan community. Touring cyclists passing through Lumby on Highway 6 would find it a solid hot-meal option with a broad menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms this is a pizza restaurant in Lumby, BC (address: 2037 Shuswap Avenue Lumby BC), not Coldstream as OSM tags suggest — the coordinates (50.248°N, 118.966°W) are consistent with Lumby. The menu page confirms gluten-free and vegetarian options; the contact page provides phone numbers absent from OSM. No website evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most optional amenities.
concerns: OSM community tag lists 'Coldstream' but the website explicitly states the restaurant is 'in the heart of Lumby' and the contact page address is '2037 Shuswap Avenue Lumby BC' — the OSM coordinates are consistent with Lumby, not Coldstream. The community tag appears incorrect.
OSM has no phone or address fields populated; both were sourced from the website only.
Holiday hours on the contact page reference 'January 01 2037' which appears to be a website data-entry error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating pizza restaurant confirmed via live website with full menu and contact details. Solid hot-meal stop for cyclists passing through Lumby on Highway 6.
enrichment_extras.notes: Text number also listed on website: 778-212-8253.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu states 'Gluten free available for any medium size only' and 'Dairy free cheese available upon request.' Vegetarian pizza option 'Garden Picks' (mushrooms, green peppers, onion, olives, fresh tomato) is listed. No explicit vegan claim

wow_evidence: local staple in this small North Okanagan community
